text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aboard the bus heading to the summer camp 
grounds. Watching the swarm of cars racing 
by at high speed, Tamamo Cross trembles, 
reminded of sudden pileups and collisions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer gently offered comforting 
words: "Let's resolve this issue during 
this summer training camp."
